additionalGuides.changes: Original, condensed explanation combining the supplied Steam tutorials. Screenshot-only steps are described in accessible text. The owner-cleared Three Person Conversations with Player note is consolidated into an end-of-guide section, with its source audit and warnings preserved; its standalone page is removed. The condition/effect and dialogue-search reference pages remain. General FCS setup is linked rather than duplicated; unrelated town/global-settings exercises and source roleplay are omitted. Older-version claims are qualified and no current-game validation is asserted.
additionalGuides.sourceAcquisition: Owner-supplied saved webpages and resource folders, read offline. Only public guide sections and selected original screenshots were used; saved HTML, scripts, styles, account data and decorative/unrelated media are not published.
additionalGuides.fingerprintScope: SHA-256 of JSON {title,description,sections}, using public workshopItemTitle, guideTopDescription and subSection titles/text. Text nodes are joined with spaces, script/style nodes omitted, and section whitespace collapsed. No Steam account/header content is included.
additionalGuides.sourceImageIndexScope: Zero-based occurrence among local image references within public subSection elements, in document order.

additionalGuides.sourceLicense: No explicit reuse license found in the supplied Steam guides. No new license is assigned to these sources; the Wiki-derived FCS CC BY-SA terms do not apply to these Steam sources.
